Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Centralizers
function: The bow-spring or rigid devices on the casing that hold it away from the hole wall so the cement can surround the pipe evenly.

tabs.overview: Placement per API RP 10D-2: near the shoe, across the pay, and where the standoff matters; bow springs for open hole, rigid types in casing.
tabs.engineering: Per API RP 10D-2 and the standoff calculation.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
